poems.title: Glorious Purpose
poems.description: A poem on love, sacrifice, and the quiet cost of choosing someone.
stanzas: Perhaps we’re never meant to stay,
And perhaps some debts cannot be repaid.
And if the truth must die with me,
I’ll let it rest where no one can see.
I ask not to be forgiven,
nor do I seek a promised heaven.
For some sins are born of love, it seems,
and some sacrifices bury the dreams.
And if silence costs me all,
if truth is all I lose,
then let this be my last confession
“You’re still the one I’d choose.”
For we are, at the end,
all just stories left unread,
Some written down in ink,
While some in tears never shed.
Cuz when all is forgotten,
when we’re nothing but dust.
“For you,
For all of us.”
Who loved.
Who lost.
Who lived.
Who must.

poems.title: याद
poems.description: Yaad, a Nepali poem by Aayush Neupane on memory, longing, and love that will not leave.
stanzas: भन्न त खोज्छु, तर भन्नै सकिनँ,
मनमा लुकेका कुरा खोल्नै सकिनँ,
यादमा तिम्रो डुब्दै छु खै किन,
सम्झन्छु सधैँ, सकिनँ तिमीलाई भुलाउन ॥
तनलाई हैन, मनलाई गर्छु,
साँचो हो माया, बाचा नै दिन्छु,
याद त हो, सायद एकदिन भुल्ने नै छु,
तर माया मा साँचो, सधैँ नै गर्नेछु ॥
भन्न त खोज्छु, मनको कुरा,
कोमल यो मुटुले हिम्मत गरेन,
आशा छ पक्कै, तिमीलाई पनि
महसुस होस् एकदिन, यो माया हो भनी ॥
मनको भावना खोल्न सकिनँ,
प्रयास त गरें, शब्दै पुग्दैन,
तर आशा छ मलाई बुझिदिन्छ्यौ भनी,
शब्द नपुगे नि इशारा छिनेर ॥
भुल्न त मन थियो, तर मनले मानेन,
लुक्न खोज्दा पनि लुक्न सकिनँ,
आँखा मा डुब्दै छु, आज म तिम्रो,
तैरिन त सक्छु, तर मनले मानेन ॥
